summary: Iteration 79 - Espace Pro Omega (ITER.57) Frontend Testing Complete. All 14 features tested successfully. Route /pro is protected and redirects to /admin when not authenticated. After login with CC2026admin, the Omega Pro space displays correctly with fullscreen immersive UI (no vitrine header/footer). All 6 orbital modules (WALLET, SHOP, FEED, INBOX, BUILD, COCKPIT) and CVL BRAIN central node are visible and clickable. Navigation between all views works correctly with back buttons returning to OrbitalMenu. Vitrine homepage works normally with 'Espace Pro' link in header dropdown.

issues: Console shows 'Error: <path> attribute d: Expected moveto path command' - SVG path animation has undefined values during initial render, but doesn't affect visual appearance

The ProApp orchestrates navigation between 11 Omega components: Background, OrbitalMenu, Logo, ContentDisplay, BrainChat, WalletView, ShopView, CockpitView, FeedView, InboxView, SovereignProfileView, BuilderView. All data is MOCKED (zero API calls). The orbital menu has 6 modules with data-testid attributes (orbital-item-wallet, orbital-item-shop, etc.) and a central CVL BRAIN node (orbital-brain-node). Each view has a back button that returns to the orbital menu.
